brief:
Five activists face prosecution in Ulm, Germany, after vandalizing a facility operated by Elbit Systems, an Israeli weapons manufacturer, Drop Site News reported. The defendants plan to use their trial to challenge Germany's role in supplying arms used in Gaza operations.

The case centers on accusations that Germany facilitates Israeli military actions through weapons sales and exports. The activists' legal strategy aims to highlight the connection between German-made weapons and alleged violations in Gaza, transforming what authorities treat as a property crime into a debate over state complicity.
dek: Five activists who vandalized an Elbit Systems factory aim to put Germany and the Israeli weapons company on trial.
title: German activists on trial for vandalism at Israeli weapons factory
